results.headline: TRADING STATEMENT AND NOTICE OF HALF YEAR RESULTS
results.key_quote: We delivered a robust first half, with customers choosing and returning to Trainline for the value and features we offer, against a backdrop of resilient underlying demand for UK rail travel. Our confidence is reflected in the announcement today of a new £100 million share buyback programme.
results.summary: Trainline reported flat Group net ticket sales (£3.3bn) and 1% lower Group Underlying Revenue (£233m) year-on-year for H1 FY2027. While the company describes the performance as 'robust' and reconfirmed FY2027 guidance without upgrade, the financial metrics show modest declines. UK Consumer was flat on net ticket sales but revenue down 5%, impacted by refund policy changes and regulated fare freeze. International Consumer declined 4% due to one-off factors including Spanish rail accidents, geopolitical tensions, and marketing discipline. Trainline Solutions grew modestly at 3-4%. The company announced a £100m share buyback programme reflecting management confidence, but the absence of guidance upgrade despite the statement suggests results aligned with prior expectations rather than exceeding them.
